notes: SEIJI AND FRIENDS. Sponsored by NEC. Mstislav Rostropovich conducted the Takemitsu "Signals from Heaven" and the Shostakovich "Festive Overture." John Williams conducted the Dvorak "Romance in F minor"; the songs by Rodgers, Weill, LeGrand, and Kern; his own "For Seiji!"; and the Berlioz "Roman Carnival Overture." Federico Cortese conducted the Glazunov "Chant du Menestrel." Ozawa conducted the Gershwin "Rhapsody in Blue" performed with the Marcus Roberts Trio and three Spirituals with the Boys Choir of Harlem. The Boys Choir of Harlem processed into the Shed singing "Alleluia" between the Takemitsu and Shostakovich works. The song was repeated as an encore with the Marcus Roberts Trio.
